xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4283: Close-out settings in the dashboard (remove workspace, delete branch, auto close-out) with disk cost and cleanup, and an honest teardown row

plan.title: Close-out settings in the dashboard (remove workspace, delete branch, auto close-out) with disk cost and cleanup, and an honest teardown row
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The [close_out] keys in ~/.overdeck/cloister.toml are not in the dashboard. With remove_workspace defaulting to false, 21 closed issues kept ~47 GB of worktrees. DoD row 9 claims the workspace was removed even when it was kept on purpose. Planning also found that auto and auto_delay_minutes are inert since PAN-3917 and that the existing PUT /api/cloister/config clobbers the whole file.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Settings Close-out section backed by narrow GET/PUT /api/cloister/close-out endpoints that report each key's effective value and source and write only the changed key. Flip remove_workspace's default to true. Show closed-issue workspace disk cost and a Clean up now action that runs pan workspace destroy for closed, merged, clean workspaces with skip reasons. Make DoD row 9's observed text say when the workspace or branch was kept. Render the inert auto keys disabled and document them honestly.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Re-implementing automatic close-out or making close_out.auto / auto_delay_minutes do anything
- Changing the closed-issue reaper (reap-issue-residue.ts) or making it honor [close_out]; investigating why 21 workspaces escaped it
- Preserving TOML comments on write, or changing PUT /api/cloister/config / saveCloisterConfigSync
- Cleanup for polyrepo workspaces; destroy with --force or --purge-memory; deleting remote branches from the cleanup action
- Changing pan workspace list --stale's merge heuristic
- Background job infrastructure or polling for cleanup
- Migrating existing cloister.toml files

autoDecisions.summary: auto and auto_delay_minutes render as disabled, read-only controls marked inert; automatic close-out is not re-implemented
autoDecisions.rationale: Their only consumer was deleted in PAN-3917 W4 (commit 94255f055fe); the Cut deliberately reduced deacon-lite to four fixed routines. A live toggle that nothing reads would repeat the dishonest-report problem this issue fixes. Rendering them disabled still shows all four controls.

autoDecisions.summary: Close-out settings use new narrow GET/PUT /api/cloister/close-out endpoints instead of PUT /api/cloister/config
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing PUT stringifies the whole merged config, which materializes every default (making every source read 'cloister.toml') and drops the operator's comments. A key-scoped write keeps source attribution truthful.

autoDecisions.summary: remove_workspace defaults to true; delete_feature_branch stays false
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue recommends true: a kept workspace has no known use after merge and close. The default applies wherever the file omits the key (deepMerge), which docs state.

autoDecisions.summary: Cleanup requires tracker-closed AND isBranchMerged === 'merged' AND empty git status --porcelain (untracked counts as dirty); polyrepo workspaces are skipped
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's 'closed, merged, no uncommitted changes' rule with the squash-aware merge check; isBranchMerged runs in the project root, which is wrong for polyrepo wrappers.

autoDecisions.summary: Cleanup runs synchronously with concurrency 2, shelling pan workspace destroy without --force
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors bulkCloseOut's synchronous bounded-concurrency pattern; the issue names pan workspace destroy as the mechanism.

autoDecisions.summary: A new 'Close-out' settings section follows the Cloister section
autoDecisions.rationale: No Pipeline section exists; the issue allows 'or a Close-out section'.

autoDecisions.summary: Screenshots are committed as Mintlify docs images and linked from the PR body
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo's docs already use images/dashboard/*-light|dark.png with ThemedImage; committing them satisfies 'attached to the PR' durably.

metadata.sizeJustification: The projected-surface lint counts each top-level doc file, the docs images dir, scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt and package.json as separate subsystems. Code spans src/lib, src/dashboard and tests/unit; the rest are three doc files, two docs images and the frontend test-subset line in package.json. The disk-cost line sits inside the same settings row as the remove-workspace toggle the issue asks for, so splitting it into a sibling issue would ship a half section. The file count is 25, at the limit; the planned move of dirSizeBytes out of the CLI was dropped to stay there.

items.title: Add close-out settings lib with per-key source and narrow write

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4283.md WI-1. Create src/lib/cloister/close-out-settings.ts exporting CloseOutSettingsView, WRITABLE_CLOSE_OUT_KEYS, CloseOutSettingsError(status 400|409), readCloseOutSettings(configFile?) and writeCloseOutSetting(key,value,configFile?) exactly as the PRD specifies. Define CLOISTER_CONFIG_FILE locally as join(OVERDECK_HOME,'cloister.toml'); do not edit config.ts. Use fs/promises only. Source is 'cloister.toml' when the raw parsed [close_out] table has the key, else 'default'. The write parses the raw file, sets only close_out.<key>, and writes stringify(raw) back without merging defaults; an unparseable existing file throws 409 and writes nothing; auto/auto_delay_minutes/unknown keys/non-boolean values throw 400.

items.title: Given no cloister.toml, readCloseOutSettings returns all four keys with source 'default' and values equal to DEFAULT_CLOISTER_CONFIG.close_out
Given a file containing only [close_out] remove_workspace = false, readCloseOutSettings returns remove_workspace {value:false, source:'cloister.toml'} and source 'default' for the other three keys

Collect closed-issue workspaces with total disk size

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4283.md WI-7. Create src/lib/workspaces/closed-issue-workspaces.ts with ClosedIssueWorkspaceRow, ClosedIssueWorkspaceReport, ClosedIssueWorkspaceDeps, collectClosedIssueWorkspaces(deps?) and clearClosedIssueWorkspaceCache() per the PRD. Enumerate registered projects' feature-<issue>[-strike|-slot-N] dirs, group by issue via resolveIssueWorkspaceDirs, keep closed issues (default isClosed = withGitHubCaller('close-out', () => isTrackerIssueClosed(id))), default dirSize = a private async dirSizeBytes in this module (execFile du -sb, null on failure; do not touch src/cli), sum dirSize per issue with concurrency 4, and cache the default-deps report for 60 s. Add trackerReadsPaused: boolean to the report, set from an injectable isTrackerPaused dep (default: readActivePause().length > 0 from src/lib/github-quota/pause-gate.ts), because during a quota pause isTrackerIssueClosed answers false for every issue. Any cache-expiry test uses fake timers.

items.title: Given PAN-1 (base + strike dirs) closed and PAN-2 open with dirSize 100 per path, collectClosedIssueWorkspaces returns closedCount 1, totalBytes 200 and one row with two paths
Given a closed issue whose dirSize returns null, the report counts it in unknownSizeCount and excludes it from totalBytes
Given a polyrepo project, the report row carries polyrepo: true
Given isTrackerPaused returns true, the report returns trackerReadsPaused: true
Given the default deps, a second call within 60 s returns the cached report and clearClosedIssueWorkspaceCache forces recomputation
Clean up closed, merged, clean workspaces with skip reasons

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4283.md WI-8. Add cleanupClosedIssueWorkspaces(deps?) returning {removed, skipped}. Per row, first failing check wins: polyrepo -> 'polyrepo workspace — run pan workspace destroy by hand'; git status --porcelain non-empty in any path -> 'uncommitted changes in <basename>' (command failure -> 'cannot read git status in <basename>'); isBranchMerged status unmerged -> 'branch not merged', no-branch -> 'merge state unknown (no local or remote branch)'; then destroy via async execFile('pan',['workspace','destroy',issueId,'--project',projectPath],{timeout:180000}), rejection -> 'destroy failed: <first line>'. Concurrency 2. Never pass --force or --purge-memory. Clear the report cache at the end. Tests use a real temp git repo with two git worktrees, one with an untracked file.

items.title: Given closed+merged fixture worktrees feature-pan-1 (clean) and feature-pan-2 (untracked file), cleanupClosedIssueWorkspaces calls destroy once with PAN-1 and returns skipped [{issueId:'PAN-2', reason:'uncommitted changes in feature-pan-2'}]
Given isMerged returns 'unmerged', the issue is skipped with reason 'branch not merged' and destroy is not called
Given a polyrepo project row, the issue is skipped with reason 'polyrepo workspace — run pan workspace destroy by hand' without running git status
Given destroy rejects, the issue is reported in skipped with a reason starting 'destroy failed:'
